description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Waligalla, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - (25/0162)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically land registrations, titles, and allocations under the Land Partition Act (1998 No. 21). It contains multiple declarations of land partitions with detailed property descriptions, plot numbers, measurements, and ownership details, which aligns perfectly with the Land Gazettes classification criteria.
